## Type of Change

-   [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
-   [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
-   [ ] 🎨 Styling update / Polish (CSS modifications, layout adjustments)
-   [ ] ⚡ Performance / Semantic improvement (HTML accessibility, optimized assets)

## Linting & Code Quality

-   [ ] **Linters Passed:** Run your local linting scripts (`npm run lint` or local IDE tools). No errors or warnings remain.
-   [ ] **Formatting:** Code adheres to project style guidelines and formatting rules (e.g., Prettier).
-   [ ] **Clean Code:** Removed all unused CSS rules, dead code, and temporary `console.log` statements.
-   [ ] **Comments:** Added descriptive comments for complex CSS layouts (e.g., complex Grid/Flexbox code) or CSS variables.

## Web Standards & Quality Checklist

-   [ ] **Semantic HTML:** Used semantic elements correctly (e.g., `<main>`, `<section>`, `<nav>`).
-   [ ] **Responsive Design:** Layout looks correct on mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
-   [ ] **Valid Code:** HTML/CSS contains no missing tags, typos, or syntax errors.
-   [ ] **Accessibility:** Elements have sufficient contrast and `alt` attributes are present on images.
